files.README.md:
# Oat & Ember Bakery - wholesale invoice export

One row per invoice. Voided invoices were cancelled and never paid; they stay in the export for the audit trail. Settled invoices were delivered and paid in full.
files.notes/delivery_windows.txt:
Delivery windows
- Chains take morning drops on weekdays.
- The Saturday run covers the market stalls only.
- Crates come back on the next visit.
